name: Talavine Code
description: C# desktop and CLI coding harness that connects tool-capable local Ollama models or supported hosted model and coding CLI backends.
compatibility: Supported model APIs and installed, authenticated coding CLIs are optional backends.
limitations: Desktop builds are previews; source setup currently requires .NET 11 RC2 and Git, with additional native desktop build requirements.
Ollama and a tool-capable model are separate requirements; model hardware and memory needs depend on the selected model.
Default permission mode is auto; commands can edit files and perform external actions. A working directory is not an operating-system sandbox.
Hosted model APIs or coding CLIs need their own authentication and network access, with separate service costs and terms. Provider requests can send repository content.
Documentation does not establish an offline-operation or telemetry guarantee; ordinary conversation and workspace files are not promised encrypted at rest.

sources.note: Documents Ollama, tool-capable models, desktop/CLI hosts, preview status, .NET 11 RC2 setup, native Windows/macOS builds and separate provider charges.
Documents command and file access, permission boundaries, provider transmission, local storage and encryption limits.
